summary: A Toronto property manager appears to lose landlords to a free builder address, a stale 2021 blog headline and no WhatsApp.

findings.problem: The site appears to run on a free Wix address with a Wix banner, though your email uses theaddresspm.ca.
findings.cost: Landlords handing over a property look for a serious company, and a builder address looks temporary.
findings.fix: Your own domain connected to the site.

findings.problem: The homepage blog items appear to be Happy Canada Day 2021 and A Year of Real Estate Opportunities from 2021.
findings.cost: Old posts tell a landlord the company may not be active.
findings.fix: Fresh posts or a clean results section.

findings.problem: The homepage appears to explain property management in long blocks of text, and I did not see fees or landlord reviews.
findings.cost: Landlords want to see proof and a price range before they call.
findings.fix: Short sections, reviews and a clear fee guide.

findings.problem: No WhatsApp appears, and booking appears to depend on a Book Online link.
findings.cost: Landlords with a quick question message other managers first.
findings.fix: A one tap WhatsApp button and a rental value form.
